name: LmTask
title: Task
description: Patient-specific workflow item that requests execution of a defined digital (eHealth) activity. Each Task represents an instance of “perform this activity for this patient”, optionally linking to an ActivityDefinition that describes the launchable activity.
purpose: To represent and manage a concrete patient-specific request to perform a digital (eHealth) activity. The Task supports assignment, handover, and status tracking between systems and roles, so that initiation and completion of the activity can be monitored within the care process. The Task can be used in both MedMij and Koppeltaal implementations (client applications such as a PGO are one possible presentation layer).

element.short: Task
element.definition: Patient-specific workflow item that requests execution of a defined digital (eHealth) activity. Each Task represents an instance of “perform this activity for this patient”, optionally linking to an ActivityDefinition that describes the launchable activity.

element.short: Instantiates ActivityDefinition
element.definition: A link to the ActivityDefinition that defines the launchable eHealth activity (i.e., what module/content should be launched or performed) associated with this Task. In both MedMij and Koppeltaal implementations, this link is carried using the Koppeltaal instantiates extension.

element.short: Reference to the ActivityDefinition that describes the activity to launch/perform.
element.definition: Reference to the ActivityDefinition that describes the activity to launch/perform.

element.short: Business identifier that uniquely identifies this Task instance within or across systems.
element.definition: Business identifier that uniquely identifies this Task instance within or across systems.

element.short: Identifier used to group related tasks (e.g., tasks belonging to the same digital care module/program).
element.definition: Identifier used to group related tasks (e.g., tasks belonging to the same digital care module/program).

element.short: Order(s) on which this Task is based. Typically a ServiceRequest represents the clinical order that triggered this patient-facing activity, and it may also carry patient-specific instructions for the activity (e.g., via ServiceRequest.patientInstruction).
element.definition: Order(s) on which this Task is based. Typically a ServiceRequest represents the clinical order that triggered this patient-facing activity, and it may also carry patient-specific instructions for the activity (e.g., via ServiceRequest.patientInstruction).

element.short: Parent task of which this task is a part. Used to link subtasks (e.g., individual measurement moments) to a main task.
element.definition: Parent task of which this task is a part. Used to link subtasks (e.g., individual measurement moments) to a main task.

element.short: Current state of the Task in the workflow (e.g., requested, received, accepted, in-progress, completed, cancelled).
element.definition: Current state of the Task in the workflow (e.g., requested, received, accepted, in-progress, completed, cancelled).

element.short: Indicates whether the Task is a proposal, plan, or order. For patient-facing activities this will typically be an order.
element.definition: Indicates whether the Task is a proposal, plan, or order. For patient-facing activities this will typically be an order.

element.short: Indicates how urgent it is to perform the activity (e.g., routine, urgent, asap).
element.definition: Indicates how urgent it is to perform the activity (e.g., routine, urgent, asap).

element.short: Short, human-readable description of what should be done. Keep the text concise and readable on mobile applications.

element.definition: The patient for whom the Task is intended.
